subject: Aligning billing rhythm & early-pay pilot for Stellar Products
messages:
From: Accounts Payable <ap@stellarproducts.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stellarproducts.com, jordan.miller@stellarproducts.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding packet + payment preference (Stellar Products)

Hi Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick setup call last week. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding packet and W-9. Our procurement team requested we flag the payment preference: Standard Net 60, but we are interested in the early-pay pilot you mentioned (Net 30 with 1% discount or Net 10 at 2% is what our CFO is evaluating).

Can you confirm what information you need from our AP team to enable early-pay enrollment? We can provide bank details, invoice contact, and a sample invoice template. Also please advise PO routing and any specific PO field values Redwood requires so our system can add them automatically.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), W9_stellar.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Jordan Miller
Director, Finance Operations
Stellar Products
ap@stellarproducts.com
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Accounts Payable <ap@stellarproducts.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet + payment preference (Stellar Products)

Jordan — great to receive these. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

- I’ve attached our vendor PO template and the minimal PO field checklist we need filled (PO number, remit-to, invoice email, tax id).
- Standard onboarding assigns Net 60; early-pay requires finance approval and a short commercial note for our Legal/Finance review.
- If you’d like the early-pay pilot, please confirm which option you prefer (Net 30 @ 1% or Net 10 @ 2%) and we’ll route to Finance with the onboarding docs.

Two quick asks for smooth PO routing: please include your vendor contact email in the ‘invoice_to’ field and confirm whether you need consolidated monthly invoicing or per-PO invoicing. That affects our AR batching.

I’ll start the internal ticket and loop Finance. I’ll also drop the onboarding artifacts into the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_po_template.xlsx (Excel)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet + payment preference (Stellar Products)

Looping in Karthik from Finance. Monica — thanks for the heads up. From a commercial stance I’m comfortable approving Stellar for the Net 30 @ 1% early-pay pilot so long as Finance signs off on the delta to our weighted cash forecast. Karthik — can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?

1) Quick forecast impact (estimated cash outflow change if we move invoices from Net 60 to Net 30 at 1% discount).
2) Any compliance flags from payments (banking country, tax ID validation).
3) If Finance can own the admin process for the pilot (we’d like to run 10 vendors on the pilot for 60 days).

If Finance approves, Legal will need the commercial note capturing the discount terms and pilot end date to sign off. Monica, can you prepare a one-paragraph commercial note I can route to Legal + Finance? Keep it short: pilot start, pilot end (60 days), discount, and rollback clause.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations (acting for Procurement approvals)
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet + payment preference (Stellar Products)

Thanks, Monica / Marissa / Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround. We confirm participation in the pilot with the Net 30 @ 1% term. Attached is a signed copy of our MSA and the vendor XML that includes the invoice_to email and remit-to bank details. Please let us know the PO number you’ll issue and whether you want invoices uploaded to your portal or sent to the invoice_to address.

For the pilot Admin: we prefer per-PO invoicing but can consolidate monthly if Redwood prefers. We’re flexible. Please advise and we’ll align immediately.

Attachments: signed_MSA_stellar.pdf (PDF), vendor_system_payload.xml (XML)

Best regards,
Jordan Miller
Director, Finance Operations
Stellar Products
